concepts.name: 01-clear-desk
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity visual proposal for INSON, an insurance survey assistant in Uzbekistan, used by employees to collect photos and documents, check extracted property information and prepare an inspection report for a HUMAN decision. This is a design concept, not a working app. Produce ONE landscape presentation image containing exactly TWO large readable mobile app screens side by side, about 390x844 logical pixels each, straight-on flat digital UI, no perspective or photorealistic hardware. Plenty of margin, fine graphic craftsmanship, crisp Russian text. Only short concept name above the screens; no design rationale or marketing copy in the image. Both screens have understated Telegram mini-app header with close/back and overflow, title INSON; small RU language control. Use wordmark INSON with INS navy and ON green (adapt contrast for dark). The workflow is "Фото → Проверить → Акт", shown with a restrained three-step indicator, first active on left, second active on right. All data is synthetic: use small "Демо" badge, no real personal data or names. Preserve these real features: upload/camera, checking document-derived fields, risk summary, preparing a report, calculator and specialist reachable. No invented financial dashboards, revenue charts, chats, approval-success promises, AI robots, gradients, glass effects, decorative blobs or meaningless metrics. Strong visual hierarchy, native-feeling controls with generous touch targets, excellent contrast. Screen 1: title "Новый осмотр", secondary "Добавьте фото и документы", main upload/camera area, "Сделать фото" and "Выбрать файлы"; two small evidence thumbnails (anonymous warehouse exterior and abstract document page), "2 файла добавлено", dominant bottom action "Проверить материалы". Screen 2: title "Проверить сведения", compact warehouse thumbnail linked visually to extracted fields; "Объект" / "Склад", "Стоимость" / "500 000 000 сум", "Срок" / "12 месяцев"; amber status "Требует проверки" with short label "Пожарная защита" and helper "Уточните наличие сигнализации"; bottom dominant action "Подготовить акт". Small secondary links allow editing fields. Keep all content legible without overflowing. A subtle evidence-to-field linkage is the product-specific signature.
Direction A — "01 / CLEAR DESK". Clinical clarity with humane warmth. Canvas outside screens pale blue-grey #e8edf2. Screens white #ffffff, navy #1d2c8f typography, green #22a85a primary action, slate text and amber warning. Elegant humanist sans like Manrope with readable Cyrillic; size and weight establish hierarchy, no tiny text. Upload is a clean large dashed-outline rectangular tray with one restrained camera icon, green action inside; evidence thumbnails are a compact horizontal strip beneath. Right screen uses clean form rows, not a grid of identical cards; provenance micro-label "Из документа" beside cost. Bottom compact navigation: "Осмотр", "Расчёт", "Специалист" with small line icons, active item green. Radius 12-16, generous whitespace, 8px rhythm, minimally perceptible shadows, continuous canvas and very subtle separators. This is the clean everyday employee workflow, not a startup dashboard. Two screens perfectly aligned.

Direction B — "02 / FIELD KIT". A decisively different composition for an inspector working on site: graphite #111a20, dark teal-grey panels #1b2930, crisp off-white type, bright but restrained INSON green #46d588 action and warm amber warnings. Outside canvas muted charcoal. Compact file count and secondary document thumbnail. Right screen leads with a broad evidence image cropped to about 2:1 then compact grounded stacked input rows; amber warning appears as a left-edged annotation physically linked to photo evidence tag. Technical sans Cyrillic, tabular values. Navigation is minimal top title/back plus an accessible bottom three-item bar "Осмотр", "Расчёт", "Специалист". Buttons broad and high-contrast, 52px conceptual touch height. No decorative glow, no neon cyberpunk, no glossy surfaces, no charts; serious professional camera inspection equipment translated into a real mobile app. Distinct from a white form with colors inverted: photo is the focal point and field values sit below it.

Direction C — "03 / SURVEY NOTEBOOK". A warm, editorial inspection dossier: ivory #f7f4eb page, warm-white cards, deep ink-navy #23314b, INSON forest-green #21804e action, fine warm-grey rules and ochre warning. Outside canvas sandy stone #e8e2d6. Use a restrained Cyrillic editorial serif ONLY for main headings, clear sans serif for controls and values. Report-like document hierarchy with generous page margins, small section labels "01 МАТЕРИАЛЫ" and "02 СВЕДЕНИЯ" and evidence numbering, not a faux skeuomorphic notebook. Left screen pairs one wide warehouse thumbnail with a compact document evidence row; upload choices are laid out as a calm horizontal action pair underneath a lightly outlined evidence tray, not a generic card dashboard. Right screen structured as a legible draft report page: compact evidence header, labeled rows with subtle dotted or fine separators and reference markers [01], warm margin note for fire-protection verification. Bottom primary green button and small text navigation "Осмотр · Расчёт · Специалист". Show the photo-to-report relationship through shared numbered source chips. Airy yet practical, sober insurance field report, no handwriting, no paper tears, no decorative stamps. Distinctive typographic document composition.

refinement.prompt: Edit this INSON Field Kit UI mockup. Preserve the two-screen composition, all colors, typography, content, Russian text, and the entire RIGHT screen exactly. Fix ONLY the LEFT screen: it is missing the primary next-step action. Make its warehouse photo slightly shorter vertically, reduce evidence thumbnails height a little, make 'Выбрать файлы' a compact secondary text action near the camera button, then insert a full-width bright green primary button labeled exactly 'Проверить материалы →' directly above the bottom navigation. The camera action 'Сделать фото' becomes a dark secondary outlined button with light text, so the green next-step button is the single dominant action. Preserve the header, stepper, main title, two added files, bottom nav and ample tap targets. Ensure no overlap, clipping, or duplicated controls. This is a precise layout repair, no redesign of the right screen or overall style.
